metaTitle: Where We Work: India, USA, UK and UAE | Designit
metaDescription: Designit is based in Noida, India and designs products for clients in India, the United States, the United Kingdom and the UAE. How each engagement works.
subtitle: We are a studio in Noida, India, working with clients in four markets. Each page below explains how engagements actually run there: time zones, contracting, standards and relevant work.
author: Designit

cta.heading: Wherever you are, the first step is the same
cta.body: Tell us what you're building. We'll suggest the right starting point and how we'd work across your time zone.

items.title: Noida headquarters
items.body: Our studio is in Sector 45, Noida. Indian clients get same-time-zone collaboration and INR invoicing.

items.title: Senior design for US software teams
items.body: EST/PST overlap, USD contracts and ADA / WCAG 2.1 AA as standard.

items.title: A shared working day
items.body: 4.5-hour offset, GBP invoicing, WCAG 2.2 AA and GDPR-aware flows.

items.title: Arabic RTL and Dubai PropTech
items.body: Seven Dubai property experiences delivered, bilingual design systems, near-identical working hours.

sections.heading: How international engagements run
paras: All our international work is remote, and we say so on every location page rather than implying offices we don't have. Live collaboration happens in a defined overlap window; everything else runs async through written updates, Loom walkthroughs and Figma comments.
Communication is in English. Contracts, NDAs and IP assignment follow the norms of your market.
